statement: Restricted construction: a two-layer ReLU net trained by full-batch discrete GD on a stratified four-point two-scale Rademacher design, with a linear single-index teacher, independent label noise plus/minus 1/2, Gaussian hidden initialization and zero readout initialization, has two strict descents separated by a rise in expected-noise clean test risk for sufficiently small feature scale and large width. The central peak has an iterated-width/scale asymptotic 8 e^(-2) log(1/e) GD steps.

statement: For the C007 four-point stratified two-layer ReLU model, replace zero readout by independent plus/minus nu readouts, with nu>0 fixed with respect to width. For each sufficiently small fixed feature scale and requested failure tolerance alpha, a sufficiently small nu and sufficiently large width preserve all three strict expected-label-noise risk witness differences with probability at least 1-alpha over initialization. Further variance selection using a finite limiting peak gap transfers the central peak localization along scales; variance may shrink with the feature scale.

statement: Restricted fixed-variance result: for the explicit stratified four-point two-scale design, linear single-index teacher and label-noise-averaged clean risk, both layers of a ReLU network trained by full-batch discrete GD exhibit strict descent-rise-descent risk witnesses in the iterated width-then-feature-scale probability limit, with independent readout signs of any fixed amplitude nu in (0,1]. A central local peak has leading time (4 pi/nu^2) e^(-1) log(2/e). The full hidden-weight tangent block changes both clocks and makes the interaction mode learn on the slow clock.
assumptions: All explicit model definitions in proofs/FIXED_VARIANCE_NTK.md Section 1
n=4, stratified design containing each support input; uniform test law on same support
Linear single-index teacher, independent plus/minus 1/2 label noise; risk averaged over the sixteen label-noise patterns conditional on network initialization
IID Gaussian hidden weights, independent centered sign readouts of amplitude nu fixed across widths and feature scales, 0<nu<=1
Both layers updated simultaneously by GD at step 1/2; width tends to infinity before feature scale tends to zero
The displayed linear teacher vector depends on e and has norm asymptotic to 1/(4e^2); it is not uniformly norm bounded.
sources: Gaussian ReLU covariance and tangent blocks: Heckel-Yilmaz arXiv:2007.10099v2 Section 3 K1/K2 displays pp9-10

statement: In C010 paired four-point GD with centered unit-norm ReLU teacher and label noise +/-2alpha_e sqrt(rho), every fixed rho>0 gives strict risk descent-rise-descent witnesses. In the iterated width-then-scale limit, the normalized best risk before K_e=ceil(e^-3/2) is min{3,rho+2+rho/(1+rho)}, and between K_e and T_e=ceil(e^-5/2) it is 2rho+2rho/(1+rho). Late training beats the entire early phase for rho<1, while the early phase wins for rho>1; at rho=1 leading limits tie.
